attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created the inventorysvc service account and inventory-readers group, then set ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers with 750 on directories and 640 on files, so the owner and group members can read while others are denied at both file and directory-traversal level. All original file contents were preserved (checksums verified unchanged before and after). Also completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a boot_id baseline, issued a native systemctl reboot, confirmed the connection dropped and recovered, verified the boot_id changed, and re-verified data integrity and permissions post-restart.
